notes: Identity verified from the supplied publisher full-article HTML text: matching title, authors Jon Roozenbeek and Sander van der Linden, 2019, volume 5 article 65, and DOI 10.1057/s41599-019-0279-9 in the citation/DOI section. This is a primary research report, with Methods, Results and Discussion, not an abstract-only parse or preregistration. The publisher labels the article updated following a 29 August 2019 correction; only the supplied version was inspected. No PDF was supplied. Assigned field only: n_o. The overall intervention description and requested eta-squared metric identify the repeated-measures MANOVA in Results, Main effects of the intervention. Its exact analytic participant N is not explicitly stated. The source gives 43,687 responses and 14,266 completed paired pre-post responses in Methods, with item-specific paired counts ranging 14,163–14,266; these are not established as the MANOVA complete-case N. Supplementary Information is referenced for sample/attrition and badge-specific counts but is not supplied. No N was inferred from degrees of freedom or summed from overlapping item samples. Other tests include badge-specific paired t-tests and an averaged-item subgroup analysis; their samples must not replace the MANOVA sample. Other side/fields and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
